'''Freethought''' is a [[philosophy|philosophical]] viewpoint which holds that positions regarding [[truth]] should be formed on the basis of [[logic]], [[reason]], and [[empiricism]], rather than [[authority]], [[tradition]], or other [[dogma]]s.

See also [[irreligion]].
